cards.title: Source-Case Susceptible/Resting Time-Kill Hypothesis and Data Contract (Non-Executable)
cards.claim: The SUP006 in-vitro source model describes growing susceptible S and resting R populations, total B=S+R, density-related S-to-R transfer and drug effect applied to S. It explored first-order drug degradation and effect delay; kRS=0 was a source-case constant-pressure/no-dilution assumption. The exact equation tables e1-e7 are image-only in the present library, so this card is a non-executable structural hypothesis and data contract, not a fitted dynamic method or target-drug mechanism claim.
conditions: Applicable only when an in-vitro time-kill question warrants comparing a susceptible/resting hypothesis with simpler explanations; this model is not a required generic time-kill analysis.
SUP006's constant-pressure/no-dilution setup, kRS=0, first-order degradation, effect delay and latent mixtures are source-case assumptions or optional candidates, not transferable defaults.
An executable S/R model requires visual verification and hash-bound transcription of original equation images e1-e7, plus identifiability and data checks.
required_inputs: Observed CFU-versus-time and actual exposure/dosing schedule, with organism, assay count limit and replicate/experimental-unit provenance.
Drug stability/concentration measurements when the objective is to test depletion as a regrowth explanation; otherwise retain mechanism uncertainty.

For any executable S/R fit: visually verified source equations, declared initial-state assumptions and data informative for model parameters. Initial resting fraction and mixture parameters may be fitted or scenario assumptions rather than observed raw inputs.
limitations: Exact SUP006 e1-e7 equations are image-only in the current source packet; do not state or fit specific ODEs until verified transcription is added.
kRS=0, first-order degradation, delayed effect, NONMEM implementation, latent mixture and the paper's LOD/2-first/omit-later rule are source choices, not universal prerequisites or cleaning rules.
Curve shape/regrowth alone cannot identify persistence, resistance, depletion or R-to-S transfer; no target-drug dynamic parameters are supplied.
cards.downstream_use: Use only as a source-case S/R hypothesis and data/provenance checklist alongside the existing general B03 time-kill design card. The equation-image gap blocks executable dynamic modeling until a verified transcription and model qualification are supplied.
cards.retrieval_keywords: time-kill PK/PD model susceptible resting compartments effect delay drug degradation density-dependent transfer NONMEM censoring replicate structure

method_recipe.estimand_and_scope: Non-executable companion to the general time-kill design/interpretation card: specify observed longitudinal CFU, censor/replicate status and competing S/R versus simpler mechanistic hypotheses. No numerical S/R state-parameter estimand is available from the present image-only equations.
method_recipe.input_contract: Observed times and viable counts (including <LOD status), experimental run/specimen/replicate identifiers, organism and exposure schedule. Stability measurements and initial-state information are conditional on the hypothesis to be tested. Verified e1-e7 equations are mandatory only for executable S/R fitting.
method_recipe.applicability_and_prerequisites: Use for a qualified in-vitro time-kill design where a source-case S/R interpretation is under consideration. The existing B03 card covers generic curve design; this companion only adds the source's latent S/R structural hypothesis and equation-extraction gate. Do not use source-specific culture conditions as universal criteria.
method_recipe.definitions_units_basis_window: S is the source's growing susceptible subpopulation, R its resting subpopulation, and B=S+R is total viable burden in CFU/mL. k_growth, k_death, kSR/kRS, Bmax, drug degradation and effect-delay terms are source model concepts, not estimable definitions without verified equations and chosen parameterization. The source fixed kRS=0 in its constant-pressure/no-dilution experiments only.
method_recipe.procedure: 1. Preserve observed CFU/time, count limit/censor flags, run/replicate lineage and exposure/stability information; do not apply LOD/2 or drop records by default. 2. Plot/describe early kill, stationary behavior and regrowth on their measured windows; compare untreated controls and exposure history where available. 3. Record source-case S/R graph in words: S growing/susceptible, R resting, B=S+R, density-linked S-to-R transfer, drug effect on S. Treat kRS=0, degradation, effect delay and latent inoculum mixtures as alternative assumptions to test, not defaults. 4. List competing explanations and what additional observations could distinguish them. 5. Stop before numerical S/R ODE fitting until M1.gif-M7.gif are visually verified, transcribed with source hash and model/data identifiability assessed.
method_recipe.formula_and_parameterization: Text-supported identity only: B=S+R. The exact SUP006 equations e1-e7 (including dS/dt, dR/dt, concentration/effect dynamics and parameterization of transfer/drug action) are present only as image links in the original HTML and are not verified text chunks. No executable differential equation is supplied by this card.
method_recipe.uncertainty_and_identifiability: Initial inoculum composition, degradation, effect delay and replicate/run variability can be uncertain. SUP006 explored a mixture model and a split residual structure for its experiments, but these are optional source-case mechanisms. Without exact equations and informative data, S/R parameters cannot be claimed identifiable or numerically estimated.
method_recipe.diagnostics_and_failure_modes: Observed regrowth can arise under multiple exposure and bacterial-state mechanisms; it does not by itself falsify the paper's kRS=0 assumption or prove genetic resistance/persistence. If drug stability was not measured, depletion remains unresolved. If CFU is below the assay limit, keep censor status and avoid treating it as zero. A misleading exact ODE transcription is a stop condition for executable modeling.
method_recipe.missing_input_and_partial_fallback: If equation images are not yet visually verified, retain descriptive time-kill and explicit S/R hypothesis only; do not substitute a fabricated one-compartment/direct-Emax fit. If stability data are unavailable, do not assume constant exposure; label drug-loss contribution unresolved. Missing target-drug parameters do not invalidate descriptive plots.
method_recipe.output_and_interpretation: Output an observed/censored time-kill summary, provenance, optional source-case S/R model graph, competing hypotheses and equation/data gaps. Do not output fitted k_growth, k_death, Bmax, kdeg, ke, Emax, EC50, gamma or mixture fractions until an executable, verified and identifiable model exists.
method_recipe.worked_example_and_counterexample: Synthetic descriptive example: CFU begins at 10^6/mL, is reported <10^3/mL at 6 h and is quantified at 10^5/mL at 12 h. Early reduction exceeds 3 log10 and later regrowth relative to the <10^3 bound exceeds 2 log10; the exact 6-h count and cause of regrowth remain unknown. Neither this shape nor kRS=0 alone establishes a specific S/R transfer rate, resistance or persistence.

claim_support.claim: The source-case bacterial system has growing susceptible S, resting R, B=S+R, density-related S-to-R transfer and kRS=0 under its experimental assumptions.
The paper explored first-order drug degradation/effect delay and applied drug effect to susceptible bacteria; exact equation tables are absent from extracted text.
claim_support.scope: SUP006 source-case hypotheses and extraction limit

claim_support.claim: The paper used a historical LOD/2-first/omit-later rule and mixture/run error model; those are examples, not general policies.
Time-kill kinetics alone can be insufficient for unique resistance-mechanism inference.

cards.source_vs_engineering_conventions: Scientific statements linked to originals; synthetic arithmetic and host review safeguards are explicitly distinguished from source-study results.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
